title: Unit Type A, Block 1, Milkwood Views
body: Two-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment (Unit Type A) in Block 1 of the Milkwood Views sectional title development in Seaview, Port Haven. 46 m2. Price includes VAT, no bond or transfer costs payable. Included: kitchen sink and cupboard. Levy R320/month. Occupation once the block is completed.

title: House Type A, Phase 2, Kingsmead Heights (Plot & Plan)
body: Plot-and-plan 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home (House Type A) in Phase 2 of Kingsmead Heights, Seaview, Port Haven. 45 m2 home on freehold stands of 140 to 240 m2. Price includes VAT, no bond or transfer costs payable. Included: gas hob, kitchen sink and cupboard, built-in bedroom cupboards. HOA levy R260/month; rates about R850/month. Occupation on completion of the build.
